headline: Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik said on Sunday that more than 12-13 million deserving people are being provided subsidised petrol at pre-war prices, APP reports.

card.desc: Ali Pervaiz Malik: targeted subsidy mustahiq logon ko mil rahi hai.

caption:
12-13 million afraad ko pre-war qeemat par petrol!
APP ke mutabiq Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik ne Sunday ko kaha ke 12-13 million se zyada mustahiq logon ko pre-war qeematon par subsidised petrol diya ja raha hai. Unhon ne kaha ke hukumat blanket subsidy se technology ki madad se targeted subsidy par aa gayi hai, aur Land Cruiser wale gharanon ko subsidy nahi di jati.
Kya aap ko ye subsidy mil rahi hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
